card.name: Emphatic 'indeed' and 'in fact' phrases
card.fires_on: The word 'indeed' or 'fact' in 'in fact' that introduces a clarifying statement in web prose. It also fires on a few mid-name pieces such as 'FD' in cefdinir and 'ed' in ephedrine.
